ko.executive_summary: Qualcomm faces margin pressure as it raises Snapdragon X prices by 10% due to reliance on advanced wafer nodes, while simultaneously confronting a legal dispute with Arm that could reshape the semiconductor licensing model.

implications.text: Qualcomm's dependence on leading-edge nodes undermines historical cost/efficiency advantage versus x86 architectures
10% price hike signals constrained margins and potential pass-through to OEMs in mobile processor market
Arm dispute threatens IP licensing framework that underpins Qualcomm's business model

ko.counterpoint: Price increases may face customer resistance if competitors can offer alternative architectures at lower cost.
